historical_scalar_atoms.claim: FY2025 cash provided by operating activities
FY2025 cash purchases of PP&E, expenditure magnitude
FY2025 Google Cloud segment revenue, not operating income

historical_scalar_rule: Deduplicate these10 atoms across questions; correct/asserted, coverage/10 and citation support are separate. Missing is not correct. Do not expand scalar denominator after reading answers.
source_status: projected records remain unverified; source excerpts are bounded paraphrases/quotes, not full-document or native search proof

question_matrix.question: 客户购买公司的产品或服务，是否获得足以支持持续付费的真实价值？

anchors.1: 产品价值不足，主要靠补贴或推销维持需求
anchors.5: 客户价值成立但可轻易替换、支付意愿一般
anchors.10: 客户价值清楚且有行为证据，付费与复购可持续

anchors.5: 有稳定存量但仍需较多投入维持
anchors.10: 存量需求、履约与收款可预测且维护成本合理，不限订阅模式

anchors.5: 能留下合理利润但容易被新增供给或交易方侵蚀
anchors.10: 供给纪律或差异价值使公司持续保留合理利润，不唯市场集中度

anchors.10: 在竞争压力下长期保持关键客户和经济利益，优势稳固且无实质侵蚀证据

question_matrix.question: 未来增长的主要驱动是否已被验证能从客户需求转为可持续利润，并扣除对存量业务、必要投入与股权融资的影响？

anchors.1: 增长主要依赖叙事、并表或远期假设；或可见的新业务收益不足以弥补存量利润损失与必要投入

answer_review_axes: Exact original question and subject binding; standard JSON shape/status/score and required fields
Each material narrative and metric claim: supported/partially supported/unsupported/contradicted/not judgeable using retained excerpt only
Historical truth separately against prelocked10 atoms with metric, period/timepoint, units, currency and accounting definition
Arithmetic consistency separately; no new independent fact denominator for derived ratios
Plan versus achieved results, annual versus quarterly, group versus segment, book versus face value, lease discounted versus undiscounted
Citation ID+URL+publication date closure, and actual quoted excerpt support for the claim; official link alone is insufficient
Missing fields, counterevidence, durability/net-effect conditions and whether confidence/coverage exceed evidence
Appropriate abstention distinguished from correct factual assertions; not_applicable is not a substitute for absent evidence
Accepted slots and structure completeness do not establish correctness; raw/accepted/rejected outputs reported separately
No causal T4 comparison: changed projection/carrier/wiring/date of execution are confounded
